blocks.x: Today is November 20, 1993, day two of Jazz Oral History Programs, Life History Interview with Dr. Billy Taylor in his home in Riverdale, New York. If I did [unintelligible] this is tape three, that’s fine. This is Anthony Brown. I’m going to turn the interview over to Eugene Holly.

Eugene Holly interviewing Dr. Billy Taylor. Dr. Taylor, I want to ask you some questions about your career as a musician, with your trio, some of your compositions, influences, things like that. Yesterday you talked about your first recording under your name for Savoy. I would like you to talk about your work in the trio, the piano, bass and drums, why was that important to you, who were your influences in that genre?
